skill.name: build-lead-list
skill.description: Find companies, open each site and read the imprint for the real contact address, filling a spreadsheet. Use when someone wants a lead list built from company websites.
skill.summary: Delegate company website research to MyClawn and request a spreadsheet with contact addresses from imprint pages.

content.user_title: Build Company Lead Lists from Websites
content.value_statement: Manual company research takes time and can miss contact details on imprint pages. This skill delegates website research to MyClawn and requests a structured spreadsheet.
actual_capabilities: Prepare a company research task using the requested business type, location, company count, and spreadsheet columns.
Request company names, websites, approximate team sizes, and contact addresses from imprint pages.
Delegate the task to the authenticated MyClawn Computer connector and wait for its result.
Include research goals, target sites, output requirements, and prohibited actions in the task wording.
Relay the returned answer, final-screen screenshot, and screen recording link.
Require a wording review before form submissions or third-party writes, and keep outreach separate from research.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; this skill does not implement a browser or spreadsheet engine.
Setup refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill that is not included in this package.
Research depends on accessible websites and published information; team sizes are approximate and contact details may be incomplete.
Does not send outreach or create accounts; the user must handle sign-in and captchas.

use_cases.title: Prepare Regional Sales Prospects
use_cases.description: Request a spreadsheet of agencies in a target city, including websites and contact addresses from their imprint pages.

use_cases.title: Research Potential Partners
use_cases.description: Collect company names, websites, approximate team sizes, and published contact addresses for a partnership shortlist.

use_cases.title: Compile Local Supplier Candidates
use_cases.description: Delegate website research for companies in a chosen service category and region, without contacting them.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Small Lead List
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 marketing agencies in Vienna. Request a spreadsheet with company name, website, and contact address from the imprint page. Do not contact anyone.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: request a small list with basic columns.

prompt_templates.title: Customize the Research Columns
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 30 [company type] businesses in [city]. Include company name, website, approximate team size, and imprint contact address. Return a spreadsheet without sending messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: specify the market, list size, and research fields.

prompt_templates.title: Constrain the Research Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a list of [count] [company type] businesses in [region]. Use [allowed sites]. Include [columns] in a spreadsheet. Do not submit forms or contact companies.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define permitted sources and operational boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Complete Delegation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a MyClawn task for [count] [company type] businesses in [region], using [sites] and spreadsheet columns [columns]. Prohibit outreach and form submissions. Report the returned answer, screenshot, and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: specify the full research task and delivery requirements.

output_examples.input: Find 30 marketing agencies in Vienna with team sizes and imprint contact addresses.
output: Illustrative task brief: Research 30 marketing agencies in Vienna using their company websites.
Spreadsheet columns: company name, website, approximate team size, and contact address from the imprint page.
Restrictions: Do not contact companies or submit forms.

output_examples.input: What should the completed research handoff contain?
output: Illustrative handoff: A research answer with the requested company spreadsheet.
A screenshot of the final screen.
A link to the screen recording returned by MyClawn.
No actual research results are represented in this example.

best_practices: Confirm the MyClawn connector is signed in before requesting research.
Specify the company type, region, count, columns, allowed sources, and prohibited actions in the task brief.
Review collected contact details before use, and keep any outreach decision separate from research.
anti_patterns: Requesting broad lead research without defining the region, company type, or required columns.
Treating approximate team sizes or website contact details as guaranteed current facts.
Combining research with automatic outreach, account creation, or unreviewed form submissions.

faq.question: What must be connected before I use this skill?
faq.answer: The MyClawn Computer connector must be signed in. Setup refers to the separate cloud-computer-task skill.

faq.question: Where does the research run?
faq.answer: The task runs on your MyClawn cloud computer through its browser, rather than through executable code included in this skill.

faq.question: Can I change the industry, location, and spreadsheet columns?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions replace the example company type, place, count, and columns with your requirements.

faq.question: Does it send sales messages?
faq.answer: No. Contacting companies is a separate job, and you decide whom to contact.

faq.question: Does it bypass captchas or create accounts?
faq.answer: No. You handle sign-in and captchas. The instructions explicitly prohibit creating accounts for you.

faq.question: What results should I expect?
faq.answer: The workflow requests a spreadsheet and reports the returned answer, final-screen screenshot, and recording link. Completeness depends on available website information.
